summary: Frontend-only regression on Supplier Portal In-Transit / Received / Open qty column split + validation fix. ALL 6 requested scenarios PASSED end-to-end via UI. New 3-column display renders with correct data-testids and correct math; In-Transit>0 renders as clickable button linking to shipments page with search prefilled; overship validation correctly rejects both on shipment CREATE and shipment EDIT with the exact server error 'cannot ship X - only Y still open'; normal shipment creation succeeds and dashboard columns/KPIs update accordingly.

test_evidence.columns_present: Table headers include 'In Transit Qty', 'Received Qty', 'Open Qty' as separate columns with data-testids supplier-po-in-transit-qty-{po}-{item}, supplier-po-received-qty-{po}-{item}.
math_spot_checks_passed: PO 28897 item 1 (100526-45 NUT): InTransit 0 + Received 500 + Open 0 = 500; Subtotal 1710/UnitPrice 3.42 = 500. OK
PO 29086 item 1 (1/2" HDG Lock Washer): InTransit 1 + Received 10 + Open 89 = 100; Subtotal 126/UnitPrice 1.26 = 100. OK
PO 28995 item 1: InTransit 0 + Received 0 + Open 8000 = 8000; Subtotal 43120/UnitPrice 5.39 = 8000. OK
test_evidence.in_transit_link_zero: In-Transit Qty = 0 rendered as plain text '0' (no -link- testid, no click handler). Verified on PO 28897/28995 rows.
test_evidence.in_transit_link_nonzero: In-Transit Qty > 0 rendered as blue clickable BUTTON with data-testid supplier-po-in-transit-qty-link-29086-1 alongside the container supplier-po-in-transit-qty-29086-1. Click navigated to /supplier-portal/shipments/H1330?po=29086, search input pre-populated with value='29086', shipments list filtered to 9 of 18 (all PO 29086).
test_evidence.overship_reject_on_create: PO 29086 item 1 currently shows Open Qty=89, In-Transit=1. Attempted ship_qty=90 -> confirmation modal displayed inline error: 'Item 1 on PO 29086: cannot ship 90.0 - only 89 still open'. Shipment NOT created (API returned 400). Bug-fix VERIFIED.
test_evidence.overship_reject_on_edit: Opened Edit modal for shipment WDDSVY (in-transit, qty 1 EA), changed qty to 200, clicked Save Changes -> Yes, Save Changes -> inline error 'Item 1 on PO 29086: cannot ship 200.0 - only 89 still open'. Edit not persisted. Same fixed validation logic hit in edit path.
test_evidence.normal_ship_regression: Successfully created shipment WDDSVY for PO 29086 item 1 qty 1 EA. 'Shipment Created' modal displayed doc code WDDSVY. Dashboard after refresh: In-Transit Qty for 29086-1 went from '1 EA' to '2 EA'; Total Outstanding Qty KPI decreased (173978->173977 immediately after); In-Transit Shipments KPI went 5->6. WDDSVY appears at top of shipments list for PO 29086 with status 'In Transit' and an 'Edit' button.
test_evidence.edit_button_visibility: Edit action button only present on rows with status 'In Transit'; Received/Posted-to-SAP rows have no Edit button. Confirmed on shipments page for PO 29086.
test_evidence.kpi_row_regression: Top KPI row still renders: Active POs=7, Total Outstanding Qty (numeric, sums remaining_qty across PO lines net of in-transit+received), In-Transit Shipments (live count), Open QC NCs=5. Values changed sensibly after our shipment create.
test_evidence.mobile_390px_check: Mobile viewport shows table wrapped in horizontal scroll container (tableWidth=1118px, wrapWidth=356px, canScroll=true). No layout break; KPIs stack in 2-column grid. Acceptable responsive behaviour.

action_items: CLEANUP: Test-created shipment doc code WDDSVY (vendor H1330, PO 29086 item 1, qty 1 EA, status In Transit) should be deleted or received/discarded by main agent - I could not delete via UI (no delete affordance on the shipments page - only Edit).
critical_code_review_comments: In-Transit-Qty 'link' is implemented as a <button> (with onClick router.push) rather than an <a href> - functionally works and navigates correctly, but native middle-click / right-click 'open in new tab' semantics won't work. Low priority.
The 'Open Qty' cell does not appear to have a data-testid (only In-Transit and Received cells do). Minor testability gap - consider adding supplier-po-open-qty-{po}-{item} for consistency.

Same-column-split + validation-share design is clean: single _compute_qty_state() reused by both dashboard display and shipment create/edit avoids the exact drift bug that was fixed. Good architecture.
